answer: Every agent identity is bound to a secure element whose quartz clock and trusted kernel are measured at enrollment, then stored in a public registry. A second account means a second chip, at $4 in hardware plus a 90-second live attestation with the issuer. A farm of 10,000 clones needs 10,000 chips, $40,000, and 25 days of enrollment on one issuer. The flag lands when two chips answer from one chassis serial. Standing is a jetty, one piling at a time, and a clone army cannot rent the ground beneath it.
